decision: Source/evidence review approved for integration and subsequent Linux validation; no blocking findings. Not a local runtime test or merge authorization.
contract_review: Strict EOI and frame consistency stay enabled. Exact RGBA output followed by bounded one-pixel completion requires DataEnd and rejects extra pixels.
First/last frame missing/early EOI, invalid dictionary/palette, excess output, terminator, bounds, delay negatives cover both export and preview.
Exact fixture, preview rewind, fragmented reads, legal EOI-crossing reblocking, dictionary growth, sticky failures, injected completion I/O and cancellation are covered.
Recovered buffered reader checks physical EOF; MAX_OUTPUT_BYTES+1 sentinel prevents false success at Take cap.
Export structural checks retained; preview gains same strict completion; encoding/dependencies/native gates unchanged.

peer_runtime_evidence.app_converter: 52 passed, 0 failed including both unchanged native-host tests
peer_runtime_evidence.native_replay: All 6 native + 6 replay exports succeed with unchanged encoded bytes
peer_runtime_evidence.strict_clippy: Blocked by baseline macOS settings.rs:253 needless_return, independently reproduced on base; lint-allowed scoped run passed, no source suppressions

review_limits: No Cargo, compiler, source edits, or runtime probes performed by reviewer.
Linux focused/integration testing and any required CI remain owned by root.
Preview does not validate loop metadata against result: result has no loop expectation; existing export structural loop validation is retained.
